title: Unknown's Better MC
description: A collection of performance mods and feature mods to make your vanilla world a little better.
body: Enhance your vanilla Minecraft experience with a curated selection of performance optimizations and subtle feature mods. This pack keeps the core gameplay intact while improving stability, boosting FPS, and adding small quality-of-life tweaks that make your world feel smoother, faster, and just a little bit better, all without straying far from classic Minecraft.
